# Markdown and cell-option reference

## Markdown

| Purpose | Source |
|---|---|
| Heading | `## Results` |
| Emphasis | `*emphasis*` |
| Strong emphasis | `**important**` |
| Inline code | `` `manuscript.qmd` `` |
| Link | `[label](https://example.org)` |
| Image | `![Alt text](image.png)` |
| Citation | `[@citation-key]` |
| Inline equation | `$y = a + bx$` |
| Footnote | `Statement.[^1]` |
| Figure reference | `@fig-change` |
| Table reference | `@tbl-summary` |

Lists need a blank line before them:

```markdown
The aims are:

- estimate the average change;
- compare groups; and
- communicate uncertainty.
```

## Code cells

An executable R cell begins with `` ```{r} `` and contains:

```r
#| label: descriptive-name
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# R code
```

| Option | Common value | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `fig-change` | Identifies the cell/output |
| `echo` | `false` | Hides source code |
| `eval` | `false` | Displays but does not run code |
| `include` | `false` | Runs but hides code and output |
| `output` | `false` | Hides output |
| `warning` | `false` | Hides R warnings |
| `message` | `false` | Hides R messages |
| `fig-cap` | text | Adds a caption |
| `fig-alt` | text | Adds an accessible description |
| `tbl-cap` | text | Adds a table caption |

Labels must be unique. Use the `fig-` and `tbl-` prefixes for referenceable
figures and tables.

## YAML

```yaml
---
title: "Document title"
author: "Name"
date: today
bibliography: bibliography.bib
format:
  html:
    toc: true
  pdf:
    number-sections: true
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---
```

If YAML parsing fails, check indentation, tabs, unmatched quotes, and whether
both `---` delimiter lines are present.

## Terminal commands

```bash
quarto preview
quarto render manuscript.qmd
quarto render manuscript.qmd --to html
quarto render manuscript.qmd --to pdf
```
